sahneler.metin: A New Jersey Transit train crashed through the end of the tracks at Hoboken.
It smashed into the concourse, and falling debris killed a woman.
The train entered the terminal too fast.
It went over the bumper block.
The engineer had severe sleep apnea.
It wasn't diagnosed until after the crash.
A medical exam had cleared him months before.
Sleep apnea screening came under scrutiny.

aciklama:
Hoboken sent a train through the end of the line at Hoboken. The cause: a train entering a terminal too fast and overrunning the bumper block.
